versions.notes: "Max DPS" now means the most damage possible in any style: main attacks only, spells, or both together, whichever is highest, after your minimums. It first finds the best spell-only and main-attack-only builds with full deep searches, then searches from those, so it never ends up below either. That takes about three times as long as a single search. It's the first goal in the form ("Most damage possible"), and what the bot uses when you ask for max DPS. Wynnbuilder's main-attack number is still there as "Main attack DPS only".

New goal: spells + main attacks together. It counts the spell rotation your mana keeps up, with main attacks in the time between casts, so builds that weave M1s between spells are judged fairly. Pick "Spells + main attacks together" in the form or ask the bot. This is the helper's own estimate (Wynnbuilder has no such number). The report also points it out when it beats spells alone and main attacks alone.

Fabled and Mythic special effects: the report now lists every special effect (major ID) in your build, what it does, and whether it's counted in the numbers; item cards say the same. Most are counted the way Wynnbuilder counts them. Three that Wynnbuilder skips are now counted too: Pas De Deux (Frog Dance deals no damage, so builds no longer overrate it), Grand Design (Storm Dance no longer adds air damage to Aura) and Self-Sufficient (the weapon special fills by itself every 12.5 seconds). Movement effects, help for allies and effects that only work some of the time aren't counted, and the report says so. Tomes are now part of builds from level 55 (tomes need level 60): the best weapon and armor tomes are picked with the gear, and armor tome slots your goal doesn't use get the ones with the most health. List your own tomes to use only those, or untick "Add the best tomes". Mythic items are now left out of every build unless you say you can use mythics (tick "Allow mythic items" in the form, or tell the bot). Mythics you wear or list in My items still count as yours.

Build from the items you have: each character's page has a My items list (type a name and press Enter; "x2" for a second copy of a ring). "Build from my items" makes the best build out of only those, and lists what's worth getting next: the items you don't have that would help that build most. You can also just tell the bot "I have these items, make a build", or use the new box in the form. A ring you have one of is never worn twice. Fixed: skill points are now worked out in the game's own equip order (boots first, like Wynnbuilder). Before, a few builds with negative skill point items could need a couple more points than shown (a friend's level 50 build needed 99, not 97). Ability points that wouldn't help your goal are now left unspent, with ideas for where to put them.

Better builds: deep search now builds around the top 30 weapons instead of 16. The best weapon wasn't always in the top 16, so some builds get a lot better (Warrior L106 +11%, Archer L100 +9%, Assassin L106 +6% in our tests), for about 30% more time. With crafted items it also designs crafts for more builds, more carefully. Crafted items are now off unless you ask for them (tick the box in the form, or tell the bot). New crafting table on results: the 3x2 grid like the game's, each ingredient's spot strength and effects, hover for stats and drops; and a live crafting bench in The Forge. The ability tree now explains itself: which abilities matter for your goal and by how much, which are just the path to them, and which are spare points you can swap freely. Fixed: the chat stopped working with an error 400 after a build. The bot's questions before a build are shorter.

"Make a build for" on a character's page now opens the chat (with the character's name typed in, so you just say what it should be good at) instead of the form. The form is still there: "Use the form instead".

Compare and share builds. Every saved build has a Compare button: two builds side by side, with their numbers, gear slot by slot, skill points and the abilities only one of them has. And a Share button: it makes a short code (fits in one Discord message) a friend pastes into their app, on the Home page or just in the chat, to see your exact build, compare it with theirs and save it to their library. Items are rebuilt from their own game data, so a code can't carry made-up stats. Also: saved builds now remember settings that change the numbers (like party buffs), and an empty gear slot no longer looks broken.

Faster deep search: about twice as fast with exactly the same builds (checked on every class, and every number of 2,000 test builds compared with the previous version). The fine-tuning, the deeper search, the shake-ups and the crafted items for the best builds now run side by side on all your CPU cores, and the scoring maths is quicker.

The bot knows your characters: say "make my shaman tankier" or use a character's name and it uses that character's class, level and gear; it can also level up characters and save builds to them. Goal mix: mostly one goal plus some of another (e.g. 70% spell damage + 30% survival). Mana check for spell builds: whether you can cast at full speed forever, or for how long. Armor powders are now part of the best build (they add health, so tanky builds get stronger).

Home page and character library: the app opens on your characters. Pick a class, then a character, to see its saved builds and make a new build for it (class, level and gear filled in). When a build is ready, a big banner asks whether to save it to a character's library. Characters and libraries stay on your computer and updates never touch them.

Crafted items: the search now designs crafted items for your build (recipe, tier 3 materials, attack speed, and the six ingredients and where each goes) and uses them wherever they beat normal items, for every class and slot. Every craft follows the game's crafting rules. The report and a new "How to craft" panel show each recipe, where the ingredients drop, and a link to Wynnbuilder's crafter. Untick "Design crafted items" (or tell the bot) to leave them out. Also: tests/run_all.py runs every check at once on all your CPU cores.

Automatic checks: every update is now tested on Windows before it's offered, including the app itself, the updater (your key, settings and history stay untouched), and a full build for every class that must be legal and never worse than before. A version that fails any check never reaches the update bar.

Ability buffs now checked for every class: each of the 53 toggles (Archer 8, Warrior 9, Mage 5, Assassin 16, Shaman 15) is tested at fully on and part on, and buffs that don't scale evenly are now worked out exactly instead of estimated. The report lists which buffs the build counts, and shows small gains as e.g. +0.2% instead of +0%.

Ability buffs counted honestly: the best Mystic Mask, Coursing Restraints for the share of time it can be up, and ultimate buffs at the same share as ultimate damage. Buffs with unknown timing stay off; you can turn any on, even for part of the time ("Contamination=70%"). The report says which toggles to tick in Wynnbuilder to match.
Switch versions in Settings: go back to an earlier version if an update causes problems, and forward again any time. The update bar always offers the newest version.
